pages.text: [#](53341a)Torment is a fixed-night dungeon of six isolated, source-shaped mazes. Each level is a perfect **31 x 31** depth-first maze: every corridor eventually connects, but the way may still be long.[#]()
pages.title: Torment

pages.text: [#](53341a)Invisible, unbreakable **Force** makes the walls and ceiling. Indestructible **Torment Stone** makes the floor, foundation, and portal frame; its green Mycelium-top appearance is deliberate, with occasional real Mycelium mixed in.[#]()

[#](53341a)Please a bound Flame Imp with valuables. Its first four returned secrets are Hunger, Fear, Anguish, and then the Torment Scroll. Use the scroll from a **large circle** outside Torment to summon the Lord of Torment. At half health he draws every nearby fighter and tracked attacker into one shared random maze level, where the fight resumes.[#]()
pages.title: The Torment Scroll

pages.text: [#](53341a)Each maze contains exactly three. They fill when the level is generated, then refill from dungeon supplies only while completely empty and after **72,000 ticks**, about one real-time hour at normal server speed. Leaving even one item inside prevents a refill.[#]()
pages.title: Refilling Chests

pages.text: [#](53341a)A Torment Portal sends you back to the safe position recorded on first entry **95%** of the time. The other **5%** sends you to another random maze level.[#]()
pages.title: The Way Home

pages.text: [#](53341a)That deeper route keeps the original return point, and Torment travel does not overwrite Spirit World anchors.[#]() [#](53341a)Defeating the linked second-phase Lord returns the fighters in that encounter.[#]()
[#](53341a)If one is offline, the release waits and carries that witch home on the next login. Passengers and vehicles cannot enter the portal.[#]()
